answer: Sanofi reported 616 tons of VOCs and 21 tons of dichloromethane in air for 2025. The VOC figure uses an annual solvent mass balance and includes an 83-ton Opella estimate for January–April; the Solvent Management Plan applies to sites or operations using more than one ton of organic solvents annually. For SVHCs, it reported 1,611,558 kg generated, used or procured; 1,494 kg leaving facilities in emissions, products, parts of products or services; 908 kg as emissions; and 586 kg in products. These estimates cover manufacturing operations and related activities and a list of 54 EU REACH candidate-list substances. Waterborne dichloromethane was reported only for two sites above the applicable E-PRTR threshold and was based on discharge-point samples.

normalized_value.svhc_boundary: manufacturing operations and related activities; EU REACH candidate-list substances
normalized_value.water_dichloromethane_method: sites above the applicable E-PRTR reporting threshold; wastewater samples collected at site discharge points and consolidated annually
